{{Quote|Jekiah Ordo. One of my best. He managed to avoid my notice for too long, but now I've put him to work.|Shae Vizla on Jekiah Ordo|<ref name="Jekiah" />}}
'''Jekiah Ordo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] of [[Clan Ordo]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. He served as an assistant of [[Mandalore the Avenger]], helping her with political matters within the clans, and was later promoted to [[Arbiter (Mandalorians)|Arbiter]].

==Biography==
Jekiah Ordo first gained recognition during a series of operations on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He fought to re-establish [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver's]] legacy, but really only succeeded in removing stigma from the Ordo name for himself and his two younger siblings: [[Rass Ordo]] and [[Layla Ordo]].<ref name="TOR:JO" /> He lost his sister Layla during a [[Belsavis operation|mission]] to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR:RO" />

In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> he demanded to speak with the [[Alliance Commander]], as he wished to know the person who would work so closely with his master, [[Mandalore the Avenger]].<ref name="Jekiah" />

[[File:JekiahOrdo.png|thumb|200px|Ordo fighting aboard the ''Spirit of Vengeance II''.]]
Jekiah Ordo later went aboard the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' to provide security for the convoy, but communications with him were cut off when the ship came under [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] by [[Clan Varad]], the [[Dar'manda]], and the [[Ash'ad]]. Mandalore sent the Alliance Commander and Rass Ordo to help fight off the attackers and ensure Ordo's survival. When the assailants fled following [[Heta Kol]]'s defeat and their capturing of [[Clan Cadera]]'s [[Clan Cadera banner|banner]], Jekiah Ordo was proclaimed [[Arbiter (Mandalorians)|Arbiter]] by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>

Mandalore later discovered the Hidden Chain's base on [[Ruhnuk]] and traveled to Odessen to inform the Commander. She would later get in touch with Jekiah via holocall as she, Rass, the Commander and [[Akaavi Spar]] were preparing to embark on a stealth mission to Ruhnuk. Jekiah confirmed that the Mandalorian fleet was in position, but expressed concern over Mandalore going in without support. Mandalore agreed with his assessment, but argued that she couldn't risk Heta Kol fleeing if the electrostatic storm around Ruhnuk failed to conceal her fleet's presence. He entrusted the Commander to watch out for her and wished Mandalore a successful hunt.<ref name="Ruhnuk">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>
{{GameLS}}
Jekiah later received a signal from Rass, requesting immediate aid for Mandalore. Subsequently, he ordered the Mandalorian fleet to descend planetside, engaing the Hidden Chain in an aerial battle over the makeshift arena where Mandalore and Kol were dueling. Jekiah personally took to the field and ordered his men to protect Mandalore, who was severely injured after being struck by [[Bask Sunn]]'s sonic disruptors. Ultimately, the Hidden Chain chose to flee the battle, so Jekiah ordered his forces not to pursue, instead choosing to focus on Mandalore.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

Later, while Mandalore was recuperating, Jekiah urged Rass to tell the Commander of his history with [[Ri'kan Kateen]], Kol's right-hand man, and how he was responsible for their sister Layla's death. Afterwards, they went to personally check in on Mandalore, who had a new implant installed. The four then discussed the presence of Ri'kan's sister, the lost Padawan [[Sa'har Kateen|Sa'har]] and the [[Darth Nul's holocron|Sith relic]] in possession, which Mandalore suspected was now in Kol's hands, hardening her resolve to stop the Hidden Chain leader before the Mandalorian civil conflict could worsen. Rass then changed the subject to the news of Mandalore's victory over Kol was spreading to the other clans, though he questioned why she stopped him from mentioning the sonic weapon. Though Rass assumed Kol knowingly used it in her duel against Mandalore, his leader was certain that Kol wasn't aware of its use and suspected the Commander had a hand in destroying it.<ref name="Ruhnuk" /> 
{{Endgame}}

Jekiah later returned to the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'', where he received multiple reports of Hidden Chains attacks occurring throughout the galaxy. While scrambling the Trat'ade forces in response, Jekiah tried to raise Mandalore for advice, but received only silence. He resorted to calling Rass just after he and the Commander intervened in one such attack on [[Port Nowhere]]. He informed them that there was no pattern to the attacks and recent intel indicated the Hidden Chain intended to strike on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and he didn't have the people to spare. As the Commander volunteered to travel there, Jekiah ordered Rass to return to his side.<ref name="Chains">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Chains in the Dark|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref> When Rass returned, Jekiah returned his focus to handling the Hidden Chain attacks, but his brother managed to deduce that Mandalore was in fact missing and snuck away to inform the Commander.<ref name="Heat">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Heat is On|[[Kessan's Landing]]}}</ref>

Sometime later, Jekiah received a message from Shae, acknowledging she should've heeded his council to rein in the clans and that she was never suited to be leader of the Mandalorians. She further predicted that if the Hidden Chain were to continue their machinations, both the Republic and the Empire would be forced to destroy the Mandalorians, regardless of which banner they carry, so she had decided to go rogue and break Darth Malgus out of prison, believing he would know where to find Heta Kol.<ref name="Sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|[[Hidden Chain flagship]]}}</ref>

In light of Shae's unilateral actions, Jekiah ordered the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'' to travel to Odessen, where he and Rass were meet with a hostile Alliance squad. He managed to convince his allies that he and the Trat'ade were present to help bring in Shae, mentioning that he had insight into her thinking, as well as a potential lead on a Hidden Chain informant. Taking the discussion to Alliance Operations, Jekiah explained they had three options: to find Shae, Malgus or Heta Kol. Firstly, one of Shae's accomplices, [[Greb Besrik]], had turned up on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] alone and likely would have intel on where Shae and Malgus were. Secondly, he had received a distress call from a Hidden Chain defector, [[Jemala Ha'rangir]], who was hiding on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. And Lana Beniko added that their excavation of [[Darth Nul's Laboratory]] might give them clues to Malgus' plans.<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|Odessen}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jekiah Ordo first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion to the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]].<ref name="Jekiah" />

During his first introduction with the player, Jekiah can be requested to refer to the player, depending on their class, either as Commander or by their original title:
*If the player is a '''Bounty Hunter''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Beroya''', the [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] word for "bounty hunter".<ref name="Jekiah" />
*If the player is a '''Sith Warrior''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Lord Wrath'''.<ref name="Jekiah" />
*If the player is a '''Sith Inquisitor''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Darth Nox/Occlus/Imperius''', depending on their light/neutral/dark side alignment from the base game.<ref name="Jekiah" />
*If the player is an '''Imperial Agent''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Keeper''', if they chose to realign with the Sith Empire.<ref name="Jekiah" />
*If the player is a '''Republic Trooper''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Colonel''', if they chose to realign with the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Jekiah" />
*If the player is a '''Jedi Knight''' or a '''Jedi Consular''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Master Jedi'''.<ref name="Jekiah" />
*If the player is a '''Smuggler''', Jekiah can refer to them as '''Commodore''', if they chose to realign with the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Jekiah" />
